articles.summary: KARLSRUHE, Germany & HAMBURG, Germany--( BUSINESS WIRE)--On 24 February 2026, EnBW and the charging infrastructure manufacturer XCHG Limited (“XCharge”) (Nasdaq: XCH) signed a long-term framework agreement. The multi-year partnership is set to strengthen EnBW’s strategic diversification in the area
articles.title: EnBW and XCharge Form Long-Term Partnership
